program.help:
Build anatomical and spike-detection channel groups from probe library entries.
Must be run BEFORE any spike-detection or sorting step (ndm_extractspikes, ndm_pca, ndm_klustakwik). Requires the session YAML to have a populated `probes:` section (probeFile, channelOffset per probe).
The plugin reads each .probe file listed in the session YAML and creates one anatomicalDescription group and one corresponding spikeDetection group per shank. The two group tables are always in sync: spikeDetection groups mirror the anatomical groups with the same channel ordering and the nSamples / peakSampleIndex / nFeatures values given as parameters.
Group IDs are assigned sequentially starting from 1. Probe and shank metadata (probeId, shankIndex) are written into each anatomical group so that ndm_estimatedrift can reconstruct the spatial geometry of each shank.
The probes[].anatomicalGroups field in the session YAML is updated to reflect the newly assigned group IDs.
Channel assignment If channelMap.map is null (the common case) channels are assigned sequentially within each shank: shank i → [offset + i×n_per_shank, …, offset + (i+1)×n_per_shank − 1] where offset = probes[].channelOffset and n_per_shank = probeFile.sites.count_per_shank.
If channelMap.map is a list it is used directly (flat or shank-major nested) with channelOffset added to each entry.
Channel ordering within each group follows the probe file order (tip-to-base for linear and octrode layouts as recorded in the NeuroNexus catalog). This ordering is assumed by ndm_extractspikes_sdiff and ndm_estimatedrift.
OPTIONAL PARAMETERS
# nSamples Total waveform window width in samples written to each spikeDetection group. At 32 kHz a 1.625 ms window needs 52 samples; at 20 kHz use 32 (default = 52).
# peakSampleIndex 0-based index of the expected waveform peak within the nSamples window (default = 26, i.e. the midpoint of a 52-sample window).
# nFeatures Number of PCA components per channel used by ndm_pca and ndm_klustakwik (default = 3).
# probeLibrary Override the probe library search path. By default the plugin searches: /usr/share/neurosuite/probes/ /usr/local/share/neurosuite/probes/ ~/.local/share/neurosuite/probes/ $NEUROSUITE_PROBE_PATH (colon-separated) SESSION_DIR/probes/
# overwrite If false (default), the plugin aborts if anatomicalDescription or spikeDetection groups already exist. Set to true to replace them.
